title: Additive Synthesis
description: Building complex sounds by combining individual sine waves (harmonics/partials) at different frequencies, amplitudes, and phases

content.overview: Additive synthesis constructs timbre from the ground up by combining individual sine waves, unlike subtractive synthesis which filters harmonics away

commercial.name: Parsec Spectral Synthesizer (Reason Studios)
commercial.engine: Up to 1,024 oscillators/partials per voice, two independent sound engines
commercial.sound_design: Evolving pads, digital leads, complex textures

commercial.name: Loom II (Air Music Technology)
commercial.engine: Up to 512 harmonic partials per patch, 34 editable modules
commercial.sound_design: Ambient pads, organic textures, evolving soundscapes

commercial.name: Radical1 (Sound Radix)
commercial.engine: Patent-pending additive engine with 'tens of thousands of oscillators'

free.name: LeSynth-Fourier
free.engine: 64 harmonics with per-partial amplitude and phase control

free.name: Harmonaut
free.engine: 32 drawable harmonics with separate ADSR per harmonic

harmonic_control.description: Shape individual partials to create specific timbres

evolving_textures.description: Modulate harmonics over time for organic movement

resynthesis.process: FFT analysis → harmonic extraction → additive reconstruction

formant_shaping.description: Manipulate harmonic relationships for vocal-like qualities
